title: I feel like I finished this little survivor game and, well... I like it
author: Defiant-Diet-485
selftext:
[https://remix619.itch.io/epoch-mayhem](https://remix619.itch.io/epoch-mayhem?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
I've been messing around with this game for some time now.

I posted an earlier version once before.

It's a little survivor / auto-battler where you start early eras, work through different eras, choose upgrades, evolve weapons, unlock characters and gradually make more chaotic builds.

It started with experimenting with the vibe coding concept, now it genuinly pulls me in more than like the playstore counterparts that inspired it.

Its good for mobile & desktop controls.

I'm mainly wondering whether the game is actually enjoyable, what still feels rough or cheap, and whether it feels like something worth making it good for a wider platform

  
Free to play

Built with heavy vibe-coded development, followed by an unreasonable amount of manual testing, tweaking and refinement. I'm not much of a redditor but found this page most relevant for this kind of thing.

comments.author: SimCFB
comments.body:
Screw you. That was addictive as hell. 

  
Good job I like it :) Keep improving it. 

Yes it's both cheap and enjoyable.

replies.author: Defiant-Diet-485
replies.body:
That's relieving, not just me then. Remember to set a reminder to take a break 😂  
Seriously though thank you, it's genuinly good motivation to keep going.

comments.author: Head-Cucumber-7222
comments.body: I played about an hour. Felt like I got stuck on no weapon. The new era banners are covering your character at the start, but the game is playing. So you can get hit and killed when you are covered by a banner, which feels bad. I also wondered how I could see what pickups. I got a rare "impact" pickup but then never saw an impact weapon and wondered if I remembered correctly or not.

replies.author: Head-Cucumber-7222
replies.body:
Visibility is kind of a problem later. The neon level 4 loaded and I couldn't figure out what was the background, what was an enemy, what was a projectile. On the first level the green guys also are difficult to see against the background.

Fun game! I want to keep playing and unlock more.

replies.author: Defiant-Diet-485
replies.body:
Thank you for sharing. These are things ive neglected to observe in this way and exactly the kind of indicators im looking for.

Of course I will look into some refinement in allignemnt with late game visibility and other insights shared. I too have found that narrow colour pallete on late game hindering finding only with evolved weapons can this be negated, but without, true visibility itself becomes another enemy.
